description: Record a refund for a return - money already sent back at the payment provider; this tool moves no money itself. The order's refundedAmount rises, its payment status becomes partially_refunded or refunded, and the reference joins refundReferences. A received return moves to completed; an approved one stays approved. A refund that reaches amountPaid also cancels parcels not yet dispatched and puts their stock back; the returned units themselves are restocked by receive_return, not here. Irreversible. Idempotent by reference: a reference already recorded changes nothing. Refused unless the return is approved or received, or when nothing is left to refund. For a refund not tied to a return, refund_order. Returns the order's id and orderNumber; get_order reads the new state.

amount.description: Minor units. Omit to refund the returned lines' value not yet refunded, capped at what is left refundable (amountPaid - refundedAmount). An amount above what is left is refused

reference.description: The payment provider's refund id; repeating it records nothing twice

name: refund_return
title: Refund return
